name: The Playwright's Prince
source:
Elinore is an aspiring playwright who planned on making a name for herself by travelling to the next town over. Unfortunately for her, she leaves just before the winter weather gets much worse.

Forced to take refuge in what she assumed was an abandoned mansion, she now has to stay with the reclusive Prince Cyrus, who's determined to keep his distance from her. As to why he wishes to do so, Elinore does not yet know.

[From [url=https://jazzbelle-dev.itch.io/the-playwrights-prince]itch.io[/url]]
